citation.title: Cross Comparisons of X-Ray Imaging Crystal Spectrometer and Charge Exchange Spectroscopy from KSTAR
citation.authors: S. G. Lee, W. H. Ko, KSTAR Team

topic: Cross-check of core impurity ion temperature and toroidal rotation on KSTAR. XICS measures Ar XVII and CES measures C VI 529.05 nm.
own_question: Do XICS and CES agree on core toroidal rotation and ion temperature across discharge types, including NBI blips and modulation?
actual_method_and_evidence: Time traces from several KSTAR discharges, measured at the magnetic axis. CES uses short NBI blips or beam modulation, typically 1-2 Hz and up to 5 Hz in one case. CES time resolution is 10 ms; XICS improved to 5 ms. The authors report reasonable to good agreement. Deviations seen at 1.4-2.0 s are speculatively attributed to CES background subtraction during fast density changes. The evidence is qualitative only: no error statistics are reported. Figures were not visually checked.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: On KSTAR, CES carbon impurity Ti/rotation requires NBI and is available only during beam-on intervals (blips or modulation). Typical integration is 10 ms. This motivates estimating the current report between or before CES samples.
claim_checks.original_pdf_locator: p.2 Introduction; p.3 Sec. II; p.5 Sec. III
claim_checks.qualification: Core chord at the magnetic axis, not the pedestal top. Ti is carbon impurity, not main-ion. The paper does not address report latency.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: The authors suggest CES analysis can deviate during fast density evolution, possibly from background subtraction. This illustrates that CES labels are conventional estimates, not physical truth.
claim_checks.qualification: The cause is the authors' speculation and was not demonstrated.

input_target_timing_if_relevant: CES uses 10 ms frames with beam modulation of 1-5 Hz. Arrival or availability times are not reported.
validation_if_relevant: Qualitative cross-diagnostic agreement on time traces; no quantitative metrics.
forbidden_inferences: Do not state that XICS-CES agreement holds at the pedestal top or in KSTAR2022.
Do not treat agreement as validation of CES as independent truth.
Do not infer real-time CES availability or latency.
Do not claim the discrepancy cause was proven.
Do not generalize from this core-only work to all CES work.
reason_to_include_or_exclude: Supports background on CES's dependence on NBI-timed sampling and on label uncertainty in KSTAR. It is limited by its core-only, qualitative evidence.
